name: LinkSwift
description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘
one_liner: A browser script that extracts the direct download link hidden behind nine popular Chinese cloud-storage services, skipping their slow built-in download page.
buyer: There isn't really a business buyer — this is a free personal convenience script for individual users frustrated with their cloud-drive provider's download speed limits.
business_use_cases: An individual user installs it personally to download their own files faster from a cloud-storage account they already pay for.
A power user bundles it with other browser scripts for personal file-management convenience; this is personal tooling, not a service to sell.
There is no credible third-party business use case beyond individual personal use — reselling access to it would likely violate the cloud providers' terms of service.

money_ideas.idea: None that doesn't risk violating the cloud providers' terms of service — there's no honest revenue model here.

steal_this: There's no legitimate weekend business to build on this one — it's a personal utility that works around a provider's own download limits, and productizing that is a terms-of-service risk, not an opportunity.
